notes.title: 🍊 YOUR 2ND CHANCE AT PRE-ORDERS AND REWARDS IS NOW HERE!
notes.notes:
Hey islanders! Today is a big day for Orange Island - and you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34802968/4bde58c4d2d304f2017dc0fb3dc6438c62910be8.png[/img]

We're proud to announce we're working with the awesome folks at [url=http://fangamer.com/]Fangamer[/url] and joining their [b]Kickstarter fulfillment system[/b] to handle our surveys and rewards. Working with Fangamer is such a big deal for us and we've spent the time since the campaign to make it super awesome - and [i]our new page is [url=https://fulfillment.fangamer.com/kindling/orange-island]live right now[/url][/i]! SO here's what you'll need to know first. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34802968/096cb9ac0a9354eeba173c828ee60bb8e82dc184.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34802968/723fc6af6f05f79630a3eaad51b7eaba83ad986b.jpg[/img]

⭐️[b] For existing Kickstarter backers - [/b]Your information is being ported over to Fangamer and you'll receive an email in roughly a week with next steps. You'll also gain access to [b]backer surveys[/b] so we can get the info we need to send you the right stuff. There are even a few new goodies available that you'll be able to add to your existing pledge – see below!

🌱[b] For new backers - [/b]This is your 2nd and final chance to become a backer of our campaign!! You can select from many of the tier bundles we had available on the Kickstarter campaign, and before checkout you'll also have access to the Add-On rewards we're selling through Fangamer to increase your total haul. Mix and match from the tier bundles and the Add-Ons to get all the items you want!

[b]This is the public link for you *non-backers*[/b], so [url=https://fulfillment.fangamer.com/kindling/orange-island]go check it out[/url]!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34802968/169d05bbf0f8b7102bf03ead91c776b2999998a5.gif[/img]

You'll see that our [b]Add-On Rewards[/b] include many of the physical and digital items that were available in the campaign tier bundles, in case you wanted to snag a second sticker sheet or didn't get those button pins you wanted the first time around. However, we have a few new interesting items for sale as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34802968/506861c29816191aec882fa947b6c1b0e480deb4.png[/img]

For the first time [b]we have a T-shirt available[/b]! Featuring the adorable main art you all know by now (created by [url=https://twitter.com/sarlisart]sarlis[/url]) we think even some of you existing backers will be tempted to pick this up as an Add-On! Get it while it's hot! Ain't it cute?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34802968/26eab8ff88724c66ab8522d1fe8efde7b9c0c437.png[/img]

We've told you before about our partnership with [url=https://www.shiptoshoremedia.com/]Ship to Shore[/url] regarding our Game OST vinyl album and Acoustic Remix vinyl album - but they will also be producing [b]cassette tape[/b] versions of [i]both[/i] of those albums! 

We'll officially do anything that's cute... <3 Be sure to pick these up as an Add-On as well!

There's also one more new Add-On reward for you hardcore NES gamers out there - you can pick up an [b]extra physical NES cartridge label sticker[/b] if you feel like installing the ROM onto a different cart or something :) A few of you asked for the option to pick up an extra cartridge sticker so that's for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34802968/7089325ccb3ebc0ed603735ca2fce7b91428330d.gif[/img]

[b]Lastly[/b], in case you were wondering, all funds from this system go directly to us! So please check everything out and support us as well as Fangamer! It's been an amazing opportunity working with the Fangamer folks on this. Not only do they make the backer surveys process a breeze for us, but putting their marketing and merchandising power behind it does so much for a small indie team like us. There's no way we could have done all of this otherwise. So big shout-outs to Fangamer and their whole team. And please consider picking up a few Add-Ons so we can keep the lights on while we continue our game dev :)

<3 ~ The Orange Island team!

----------------------------------------------

**The entire [i]physical postcard[/i] reward, the artwork design of the [i]physical sticker sheet[/i] reward, the artwork designs of the [i]physical buttons/pin badges[/i] reward, the artwork design of the [i]physical poster[/i] reward, the artwork design of the [i]OST vinyl[/i] and [i]acoustic vinyl[/i] rewards, and the entire [i]physical Pink NES cartridge + commemorative coin[/i] reward are all still [b]exclusive to this campaign[/b]. This is the last opportunity to receive those specific items with those exact designs exclusively for Kickstarter & Fangamer campaign backers. Final exclusive designs subject to change and may vary slightly!

notes.title: Screenshot Saturday Sundays: snowball safety, squishy slimes, and shield skateboards
notes.notes:
Screenshot Saturday, a lovely showcase of all things upcoming games. Screenshot Saturday Sundays, where I pick just a few for us to gawk at, in the full knowledge that making games is hard and anything could happen to change, delay, or prevent the best-laid plans of these developers. This week: a library to escape the cold, an island full of friendly slimes, and skate tricks on an alien planet.

(more…)
